text: Abraham, who had pleaded for Sodom, is in Genesis 22 carried through three days of travel which work like a suspended sentence. Outwardly nothing happens; in significance everything happens. The servants, the wood, the knife, and the fire are carefully named, and the instruments of the act are set in view before the act itself happens. Faith here takes the form of a structured relation or arrangement; obedience and horror stand side by side, and neither is suffered to prevail in Genesis 22.
